name: eng-agent-governance
summary: Owns delegated scope, responsibility, independence, shared-resource coordination, and result handoff constraints without controlling runtime lifecycle.
input_contract: For the chosen action: outcome, executor, inputs/output, scope and authority; relevant WorkItem or Session references, explicit budgets and leases only when applicable.
